name: Tone
source:
Main character leaves his hometown and enters an urban school without having any particular goals. He does not go home even on vacations, but this winter he goes back because of a worried letter of his sister. As he meets friends, he feels that time frozen back then starts to move again. Nostalgia overpowers him, and with that love approaches.

[Modified from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
